parameters.jsonBody:
{
  "platform_settings": {
    "data_collection": {
      "full_name": { "type": "string", "description": "Customer full legal name" },
      "mobile_phone": { "type": "string", "description": "Customer mobile phone number, digits only" },
      "email": { "type": "string", "description": "Customer email address" },
      "postal_code": { "type": "string", "description": "Customer ZIP or postal code" },
      "date_of_birth": { "type": "string", "description": "Customer date of birth (YYYY-MM-DD)" },
      "preferred_language": { "type": "string", "description": "Preferred language: German or English" },
      "line_of_business": { "type": "string", "description": "One of the five Unica retail lines: car, liability, home_contents, legal, or life" },
      "lead_intent": { "type": "string", "description": "New, Switch, Price-shop, Renewal, or Mandatory" },
      "effective_date": { "type": "string", "description": "Desired coverage effective date" },
      "budget": { "type": "string", "description": "Stated budget if provided" },
      "current_carrier": { "type": "string", "description": "Current insurance carrier if switching" },
      "current_premium": { "type": "string", "description": "Current premium if provided" },
      "policy_expiration": { "type": "string", "description": "Current policy expiration date" },
      "prior_claims": { "type": "string", "description": "Claims in last 5 years" },
      "prior_lapse": { "type": "string", "description": "Any lapse in prior coverage" },
      "consent_tcpa": { "type": "boolean", "description": "True if caller gave TCPA contact consent" },
      "consent_recording": { "type": "boolean", "description": "True if caller consented to recording" },
      "indicative_quote": { "type": "string", "description": "Indicative price range quoted, product and line" },
      "line_specific_details": { "type": "string", "description": "All line-specific details captured" },
      "conversation_summary": { "type": "string", "description": "Concise summary of the conversation and what the customer wants" },
      "missing_mandatory_fields": { "type": "string", "description": "List of any mandatory fields not captured" }
    }
  }
}
